entries.name: NFUSION_TOKEN
entries.description: An nFusion Solutions Market Data API token, sent as the token query parameter to read metal spot prices and their daily history. The API is GET-only market data, so the token can only read; the connector only ever sends GET requests and never puts the request URL in a log or error.
howToGet: nFusion issues credentials under a service agreement or a free trial; there is no sandbox.
Sign in to the nFusion dashboard, open the Connections page, then API Keys, and copy the Market Data API token.
Put it straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat, an issue or a URL you share: the token travels in the request URL.
